mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_product ( rent_product_id, seller_name, title, price, description, image_blob, duration_type, status, renter_name, end_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{rentProductId}, #{sellerName}, #{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{imageBlob, jdbcType=BLOB}, #{durationType}, #{status}, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT rent_product_id, seller_name, title, price, description, image_blob, duration_type, status, renter_name, end_at, created_at FROM rent_product ORDER BY rent_product_id DESC
SELECT rent_product_id, seller_name, title, price, description, image_blob, duration_type, status, renter_name, end_at, created_at FROM rent_product WHERE rent_product_id = #{rentProductId}
SELECT * FROM rent_product WHERE seller_name = #{sellerName} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM rent_product WHERE renter_name = #{renterName} ORDER BY end_at DESC
